en: "What's wrong?"{w}
"No, it's nothing.{w}

{0E}"No, it's nothing.{0F}
You lot look like a pretty good party."{w}

"Well, duh. It's parties like ours, with a unicorn,
that are the rare ones, y'know."{w}
"Having me around proves you've got an Innocent, after all!"{w}
note: Innocent = never changed class (cf. Innocent series, pilot row 33); a unicorn stays only with an Innocent, which drives Mig's fear of Electra changing class later in the scene. Mig: no pronoun used (gender unknown).

en: "Yeah, yeah, sure, you're right."{w}
"Miss! It's about time we..."{w}
note: o-jou = 'Miss' as in wmap slice_04 (a form of address; Electra's gender stays unassumed).

en: "You're right.{w}

{0E}"You're right.{0F}
We won't lose next time, you hear? See you!"{w}
"But I really do need to study...{w}Even you can read and write, right, Yamuru?"{w}
note: Addressed to Yamuru: the reply ('harsh way to put it') settles it.

en:
"That's a harsh way to put it.
What good's a bounty hunter who can't read a wanted poster?"{w}

"I can't read, but
it's never been a problem, y'know?"{w}
"Then I'll teach you.{w}Perhaps we'll hold a little study session one of these days, hm?"{w}
note: Korbitz answers Maniron (who can't read).

en: "I hate studyyying..."{w}
"But what about textbooks and... how would we pay for it all?"{w}
"Oh, we'll manage somehow."{w}
"Electra, Electra, look!"{w}
"Oh my! You again, and in a place like this!"{w}
"We must be tied together by quite some fate, eh?"{w}

"We've been getting stronger too, you know,
so we won't lose this time!"{w}
"All right then,{w}let's go, everyone!"{w}
"Mighty impressive, you lot, same as ever!"{w}
note: Post-battle line: Mokero praises the winning player party (same pattern as row 290 'You guys are amazing').

en:
"Oh, that reminds me.
Do you guys know anything about the Moonlight Spirit?"{w}
note: Maniron asks the player party (kimitachi). Moonlight Spirit / Sun Spirit as in wmap slices 02/10.

en: "You really do go at your own pace.{w}The Moonlight Spirit? Don't you mean the Sun Spirit?"{w}
"Nope, the Moonlight Spirit.{w}I've been sorta-kinda looking for it.{w}And not finding it just makes me even more curious~"{w}
"For all that, you guys sure know a lot too...{w}I really do have to study.{w}
note: anata-tachi here = Electra's own companions (Yamuru/Maniron just showed off their knowledge); 'you guys' keeps it open.

en: "Then just change classes."{w}
"Ninja! You should be a ninja!{w}YAMURU IS DECAPITATED!{w}
note: Wizardry-style critical-hit message in caps (source in kana, system-message style).
chiin = the Buddhist altar bell rung for the dead; 'Rest in peace' added to carry the death-bell sense.

en: "Why's it gotta be me!?"{w}

"Oh, pipe down.{w}Nobody needs a thief who can't even
disarm traps!"{w}
note: Aimed at Yamuru (has thief skills and misjudged a trap in pilot row 362).
Wizardry homage: ishi no naka ni iru is the teleport-into-rock wipe message. Centered line kept on its own line with a few spaces.

en: "W-wait a minute..."{w}
"That's right! Electra, don't give up!{w}You're going to make loads of money as an alchemist, right?{w}Don't go bending your convictions!"{w}
"Listen.{w}Electra, you need to cut it out too.{w}If you're going to keep wavering, I'm out."{w}
note: ore wa oriru = quit the party.

en: "Wh-what... Yamuru...{w}What's gotten into you all of a sudden...?"{w}
"Someone who does things by halves drags everyone else down too."{w}
"Aw, don't go sayin' that, chief!{w}I'll just dig in twice as hard to make up for it, I will!"{w}
note: nii-san -> 'chief' (wmap slice_05 choice; gender-neutral, Yamuru's gender is unknown).

en:
"That's right!
Electra's trying really hard too, you know!"{w}

"You ought to think a little harder{w}about what you're actually
saying."{w}
note: Yamuru to Mig: Mig's cheering keeps Electra from changing class, which also suits Mig (see row 324).

en: "Big talk from someone who's changed class before!"{w}
note: Mig retorts that Yamuru has changed class (tenshoku keikensha).
Mild reproach to Mig.

en: "...I'll stick with you a little longer, at least.{w}You can start studying bit by bit, too.{w}So make up your mind."{w}

"......Yeah... You're right...
I'll try a little longer...{w}...Is that okay?"{w}
"...Fine.{w}Anyway, let's move on.{w}Hanging around here forever won't get us anywhere."{w}
"Okay!{w}Well then, you guys take care too, okay?"{w}
note: Electra to the player party.

en: "Dvel Soft Steel and Frozen Elven Iron..."
note: Item names: 'Dvel Soft Steel' (wmap slice_09 x3; wmap slice_05 has 'Mild Steel' once), 'Frozen Elven Iron'. ITEM.CSV not yet translated (max 20).

en: "Those two together make an Angel's Window...{w}I know that one, since I've made it before.{w}
note: Electra reading a recipe list (RENKIN_TXT: Dvel Soft Steel x Frozen Elven Iron = Angel's Window).
Mazurite (wmap slice_05 coinage; ITEM.CSV 443 untranslated). JP gag: she misreads the middle kanji as 'ao'; English: she mangles the end of the word. Mokero corrects the fumbled part next row.

en: "Miss, that bit's read 'rite'..."{w}
note: Mokero gives the correct reading of the part she fumbled (JP: 'sou').

en: "Huh? Oh, so this is read 'Mazurite'!"{w}
"...Heyyy, and you call yourself an alchemist~~..."{w}
"B-but I know the actual stuff, and I can do the alchemy with it,{w}and I even know what it's called!{w}...Even if I didn't know how to read it."{w}
"It's that sort of carelessness, you see,{w}that gets you embarrassed in front of others like this...{w}Now, can you write 'Mazurite'?"{w}
"Um... 'Mazuright'..."{w}
note: JP: wrong kanji with the same reading; English: homophone misspelling.

en: "Ooh, that's our Miss! Bang on, it is!"{w}
"...Isn't something kinda off?"{w}
"'Mazurite'... Like this."{w}
"It looks close and it's pronounced the same, so what's the big deal!"{w}
"Now, now, take your time learning it.{w}Sixty out of a hundred... I'd say, hm?"{w}

"Way to go, Electra!
That's a higher score than last time!"{w}

"I guess.........{w}Hmm, with this stuff, I guess the only way
is to write it out a lot until it sticks..."{w}
note: Distracted, flat reply; it makes Mig feel brushed off (rows 385-388).

en: "...Electra?"{w}

"Ahahahaha!
Mig, Electra thinks you're a pain!"{w}

"Huh!? That's not true, Mig!
Thank you, okay?"{w}
"...Am I getting in your way, Electra?"{w}
note: Mig names Electra while speaking to Electra; rendered as direct address.

en: "You're overthinking it. It's fine!{w}

{0E}"You're overthinking it. It's fine!{0F}
Oh, so it is you guys.{w}Sorry I'm always so slow to notice!"{w}
note: Electra greets the player party, who walked up unnoticed; this sets up the ninja/thief jokes.

en: "Maybe they're all ninjas?{w}
note: Maniron: they sneak up like ninjas.

en:
{0E}"Maybe they're all ninjas?{0F}
Off with their heads, chop!"{w}

"Nah, nah, maybe{w}every last one of 'em's a thief,
same as me, eh?"{w}
note: Mokero is a thief.

en: "Okay, okay, that's enough!{w}Now then, let's put all that studying to the test!{w}...Mig?"{w}

"No, it's nothing, Electra!
Let's show them what we can do!"{w}
"Yeah, let's!"{w}
"...Heeeads!"{w}
"...Electra, am I really not getting in your way?"{w}
"Seriously, what's wrong?{w}Of course you're not."{w}
